textwithimage.text:
Based on TQMx80UC 8th Generation Intel® Core™ Processor

The STKx80UCis a high-performance embedded computing solution, featuring Intel® Core™ processors with impressive clock speeds and up to 64 GB of DDR4-2400 SO-DIMM memory. It boasts a wide range of connectivity options, including four USB 3.1 Gen 2 ports and support for up to three independent displays with 4K resolution. Additional features such as eMMC flash storage, Gigabit Ethernet, and PCIe interfaces make it a versatile choice for various applications. The STKx80UC offers extended temperature operation and supports Intel® RST for PCIe 3.0 storage, making it a robust solution for demanding embedded computing needs.

text.text:
Features

  • High-Performance Intel® Core™ Processors: Equipped with Intel® Core™ i7, i5, i3, or Celeron® processors for robust computing power.
  • DDR4 Memory Support: Provides options for up to 64 GB of DDR4-2400 SO-DIMM memory.
  • Versatile Connectivity: Features four USB 3.1 Gen 2 ports, Gigabit Ethernet, and support for three independent displays with 4K resolution.
  • eMMC Flash Storage: Offers onboard eMMC flash storage ranging from 8 GB to 128 GB for data storage.
  • Extended Temperature Operation: Supports a wide temperature range, from -40°C to +85°C, making it suitable for challenging environments.

CPU
  • Core™ i7-8665UE (4x 1.7/4.4 GHz, 8 MB, 15 W)

Communications Interfaces
  • 1x Gbit Ethernet (Intel® i219-LM)
Other Interfaces
  • 4x USB 3.1 Gen 2
  • 8x USB 2.0
  • 2x SATA Gen 3 (up to 6 Gb/s)
  • 1x PEG Port with PCIe x1 Gen
  • 3 8x PCIe Gen 3 (4 x 1 or 1 x 4 or 2 x 2)
  • 1x LPC bus
  • 1x Intel® HD audio (HDA)
  • 1x I2C (master/slave capable)
  • 1x SMBus (HW monitor)
  • 1x SPI (for external uEFI BIOS flash)
  • 2x Serial Port (Rx/Tx, legacy compatible)
  • (4 wire optional through TQ flexiCFG)
  • 8x GPIO or SD Card
General
  • Onboard Flash eMMC with 8 GByte, 16 GByte, 32 GByte, 64 GByte or 128 GByte
  • Power supply Input Voltage: 8.5…20 V
  • Environment Standard Temperature: 0 °C…+60 °C Extended Temperature: –40 °C…+85 °C Storage temperature: –40 °C…+85 °C
  • Form factor/ dimensions COM Express® Compact, type 6, PICMG COM.0 R3.0 95 mm x 95 mm PCIE Storage Support Intel® RST for PCIe 3.0 Storage Ports (e.g. x4 M.2 modules) and Intel® Optane™ memory support
